bank.q: My brother ___ football on Saturdays.
bank.why: He/she/it memakai verb + s di present simple: plays.

bank.q: We ___ students at the same school.
bank.why: We memakai are.

bank.q: I need ___ umbrella because it is raining.
bank.why: Umbrella diawali bunyi vokal, jadi memakai an.

bank.q: The keys are ___ my bag, not on the desk.
bank.why: In my bag = di dalam tas.

bank.q: ___ do you have lunch? At noon.
bank.why: Jawaban berupa jam (at noon), jadi pertanyaannya What time.

bank.q: A person who teaches students is a ___.
bank.why: Teacher = guru, orang yang mengajar murid.

bank.q: Yesterday I ___ to the market with my aunt.
bank.why: Yesterday menandakan masa lalu. Bentuk lampau go adalah went.

bank.q: There are three ___ in the garden.
bank.why: Plural dari child tidak beraturan: children.

bank.q: This is Anna. ___ bag is blue.
bank.why: Sebelum kata benda dipakai possessive adjective: her bag.

bank.q: ___ you swim? Yes, I can.
bank.why: Pertanyaan dengan modal can: Can + subjek + verb.

bank.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
bank.why: First conditional: If + present simple, will + verb.

bank.q: She has worked here ___ three years.
bank.why: For dipakai untuk durasi (three years). Since untuk titik waktu.

bank.q: When I was a child, I ___ play outside every afternoon.
bank.why: Used to + verb untuk kebiasaan di masa lalu.

bank.q: The tea is ___ hot to drink.
bank.why: Too + adjective + to + verb = terlalu ... untuk ...

bank.q: I am interested ___ learning Japanese.
bank.why: Kolokasi tetap: interested in.

bank.q: She avoided ___ the question.
bank.why: Setelah avoid memakai gerund (verb-ing).

bank.q: Her new phone is ___ than her old one.
bank.why: Adjective panjang memakai more + adjective + than untuk perbandingan.

bank.q: The book ___ I bought yesterday is very interesting.
bank.why: Which dipakai untuk benda. Who untuk orang, whose untuk kepemilikan.

bank.q: The bridge ___ in 1998.
bank.why: Pasif lampau: was/were + past participle. In 1998 = masa lalu.

bank.q: Please ___ me your pen. I forgot mine.
bank.why: Lend = meminjamkan. Borrow = meminjam.

bank.q: If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
bank.why: Third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

bank.q: I wish I ___ how to play the piano.
bank.why: Wish untuk keadaan sekarang yang tidak nyata memakai past simple: knew.

bank.q: Never before ___ such a beautiful sunset.
bank.why: Setelah Never before di awal kalimat, auxiliary dibalik sebelum subjek: have I seen.

bank.q: ___ being tired, she finished the report.
bank.why: Despite + verb-ing/kata benda = meskipun. Although harus diikuti klausa lengkap.

bank.q: He decided to ___ a risk and invest all his savings.
bank.why: Kolokasi tetap: take a risk.

bank.q: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
bank.why: Past perfect untuk kejadian yang terjadi lebih dulu dari kejadian lampau lain.

bank.q: He has lived in Paris for ten years, so he ___ speak French well.
bank.why: Must menyatakan kesimpulan yang sangat kuat. Ia sudah 10 tahun di Paris.

bank.q: He asked me, "Where do you live?" -> He asked me where ___.
bank.why: Dalam reported question urutan kata seperti kalimat biasa dan tense mundur: I lived.

bank.q: The report, ___ was published last week, caused a debate.
bank.why: Pada non-defining clause (diapit koma) dipakai which, bukan that.

bank.q: The manager asked us to ___ the form by Friday.
bank.why: Submit = menyerahkan. Admit = mengakui, permit = mengizinkan.

bank.q: The doctor insisted that he ___ more rest.
bank.why: Setelah insist that dipakai bentuk dasar verb (subjunctive): get.

bank.q: ___ I need most is a long holiday.
bank.why: Pseudo-cleft: What + klausa + is ... = Yang paling saya butuhkan adalah ...

bank.q: Hardly had we sat down ___ the lights went out.
bank.why: Pola tetap: Hardly had + subjek + past participle + when.

bank.q: ___ the instructions, he assembled the shelf quickly.
bank.why: Having read = setelah membaca (aktif, selesai lebih dulu). Subjeknya he.

bank.q: Tom is outgoing, ___ his sister is rather shy.
bank.why: Whereas menyatakan kontras antara dua hal.

bank.q: I am going to ___ my car repaired tomorrow.
bank.why: Causative: have + objek + past participle = menyuruh/meminta seseorang memperbaiki.

bank.q: Don't worry about the quiz. It is a piece of ___.
bank.why: Idiom a piece of cake = sangat mudah.

bank.q: His argument was so ___ that nobody could refute it.
bank.why: Cogent = meyakinkan dan kuat. Vague = tidak jelas, trivial = remeh.

bank.q: ___ you drive carefully, you can borrow the car.
bank.why: Provided (that) = asalkan. Unless artinya kecuali, tidak cocok di sini.

bank.q: I have ___ read the book nor seen the film.
bank.why: Pasangan tetap: neither ... nor ...

articles.title: Dina's Birthday
body: Today is Dina's birthday. She is twelve years old. Her mother makes a big chocolate cake in the morning.
In the afternoon, five friends come to her house. They bring small gifts. Dina gets a book, a pencil case and a red scarf. Everybody sings a song and she blows out the candles.
After the cake, they play games in the garden. At six o'clock, the friends go home. Dina is tired, but she is very happy.

qs.q: What time do the friends go home?

articles.title: Why We Procrastinate
body: Almost everyone puts off tasks from time to time. Researchers say that procrastination is not simply laziness. It is often a way of avoiding unpleasant feelings, such as fear of failure or boredom with a task.
When we delay, we feel better for a short time, but the stress usually returns, and it is often stronger. As the deadline gets closer, we may rush and produce work of lower quality.
Experts suggest breaking a large task into small steps and starting with just five minutes. Once we begin, the task usually feels less frightening, and we are more likely to continue.

qs.q: According to researchers, procrastination is often
opts: a way of avoiding unpleasant feelings
a result of working too fast

qs.q: What usually happens after we delay a task?
opts: The stress comes back, often stronger.
Wait until the deadline is close
Work on several tasks at once
Break the task into small steps and start briefly
